# Anne Shirley & Ruby Gillis

A Tempest in the School Teapot P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P20](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. ## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk to school, discussing their scenic route, local school gossip, and the return of [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). In the classroom, Gilbert pulls Anne's braid and calls her 'Carrots,' prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to smash her slate over his head in anger. Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) punishes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by making her stand in front of the class, and despite Gilbert's contrite apology afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses to forgive him.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

A Tempest in the School Teapot P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044)_

> After being punished by Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) and forced to sit with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses to return to school. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) consults Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who advises letting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stay home until she cools off. Later at home, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) laughs heartily after finding [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) weeping over an imagined future where [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) gets married.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

A Tempest in the School Teapot P96](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0096)_

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) meets [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to say a tearful goodbye after her mother forbids them from playing together, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) devastated. To cope with her sorrow, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) decides to return to school, where she is warmly welcomed back by her classmates and secretly exchanges notes with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) throws herself into her studies, maintaining an intense academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P16](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. > During a party, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accepts Josie Pye's dare to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's roof, resulting in a fall that breaks her ankle. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) realizes how deeply she cares for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as the injured girl is brought home, and during her weeks of recovery, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys visits from friends while eagerly anticipating returning to school under their new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md).
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school in October and thrives under the guidance of her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). She enthusiastically shares her school activities with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), including plans for an upcoming Christmas concert. While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) remains skeptical of the festivities, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) offers [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) his warm encouragement.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) turns thirteen and talks with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) on their walk to school about growing up, writing compositions, and her melodramatic story. Inspired, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) forms a story club with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), Ruby, and Jane, which [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) scoffs at when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) describes their efforts.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends reenact Tennyson's Elaine on a leaky flatboat, forcing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to cling to a bridge pile until [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) rescues her. When Gilbert apologizes and asks to be friends, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses, though she later reflects on her foolishness with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).
>

> As the school term ends, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) reassures her students that she will return next year to prepare them for the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resolves to spend her summer vacation playing and letting her imagination run free. Meanwhile, [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for tea and praises [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) for how remarkably well [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has grown and improved over the past three years.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) settles into student life at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy), forming close friendships and maintaining her healthy academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). She spends time visiting [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) and eventually prepares alongside her [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) classmates as spring brings upcoming final examinations.
